newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise unit wins Seychelles contract.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise unit wins Seychelles contract.

text.p: Sita, a unit of French utilities group Lyonnaise des Eaux, said on Tuesday it has won a 20-year contract with the Seychelles government for solid waste collection and treatment, financed by the European Union.

An official of the Seychelles Foreign Affairs Ministry said the value of the contract depended on the amount of waste collected each year and the estimated investment by Sita in new plant and ancillary equipment for composting and compacting the waste was $8 million. The programme was intended to bring Seychelles standards up to those of the European Union, he said.
